# mapuce

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of mapuce is to Convert RP INDCVI detail files to semantic data input for MAPUCE models.

The mapuce package contains a set of functions to check, extract and transform variables from the RP INDCVI detail files from the french census, in order to prepare them for mapuce models.

## Installation

This package is not available on CRAN, to install it please use the following commands:

From GitHub:

``` r
remotes::install_github("AcidyBee/mapuce")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(mapuce)
## basic example code
```

You can describe model modalities using the following command:

```{r model_eq}
describe_model_modalities(model_eq)
```
